title: Q-TRAJ-neglected-demos: demos had 1346 lines of change, then nothing for 7 days while the rest of the system moved
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** trajectory pass (TRAJECTORY-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation trajectory --probe neglected:demos
**Status:** open

demos had 1346 lines of change, then nothing for 7 days while the rest of the system moved. Evidence: quiet_days 7; system change in the last 7 days 345451.

Find why it went quiet while the system moved: a loop that no longer fires, an area nothing consumes. Fix the loop or retire the area with a recorded disposition.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation trajectory --probe neglected:demos` exits 0.
